operators.name: zero_pad2d_forward

parameters.name: x
parameters.shape: input tensor shape from reference step (batch, channels, height, width)
parameters.layout: supports strides, input must be contiguous as per reference behavior

returns.shape: same as reference step_001/002 output: (batch, channels, height + pad_top + pad_bottom, width + pad_left + pad_right)

semantics: Implements nn.ZeroPad2d with padding (pad_left, pad_right, pad_top, pad_bottom).
Output is obtained by copying input into the interior of a zero tensor of size input_shape + padding.
No bias or scaling; zeros are placed in padding regions.
The input tensor must be contiguous; output is contiguous as expected by subsequent torch.cat.

operators.name: cat_forward

parameters.name: x1
parameters.shape: first tensor for concatenation, shape from reference step_001
parameters.layout: supports strides, input must be contiguous as per reference behavior

parameters.name: x2
parameters.shape: second tensor for concatenation, shape from reference step_002
parameters.layout: supports strides, input must be contiguous as per reference behavior

returns.shape: same as reference step_003 output: concatenation along dim (for this task dim=1)

semantics: Concatenates x1 and x2 along dimension dim (here dim=1).
The output is contiguous and maintains the same data order as torch.cat.
All other dimensions must match.
Both inputs must be contiguous.
Applies nn.ZeroPad2d with padding (1,1,1,1) to input x1.
Input shape: (512,3,256,256) float32 -> output shape: (512,3,258,258) float32.
Zero padding is inserted at left, right, top, bottom borders by 1.
Output is a fresh contiguous tensor on the same device.
Applies nn.ZeroPad2d with padding (1,1,1,1) to input x2.
Input shape: (512,3,256,256) float32 -> output shape: (512,3,258,258) float32.
Zero padding is inserted at left, right, top, bottom borders by 1.
Output is a fresh contiguous tensor on the same device.
Concatenates padded x1 and x2 along dim=1.
Result shape: (512,6,258,258) float32.
Output is contiguous in row-major order, channels interleaved as x1 channels then x2 channels.
No additional computation.
